repos.description: Map of org/repo keys to per-repository configuration.

checkout_directory.description: Relative path under JUDGE_WORKSPACE_ROOT for this repo's checkout.

merge_strategy.description: Default PR merge strategy for all repos.

max_executor_retries.description: Maximum number of executor retry attempts per work unit when judge reviews fail. Default: 10.

use_bedrock.description: Whether to route LLM calls through AWS Bedrock.

bedrock_region.description: AWS region for Bedrock API calls.

judge_model.description: Model identifier used by judge agents.

executor_model.description: Model identifier used by the executor agent.

allowed_orgs.description: List of GitHub organisations permitted for operations.

display_timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London') applied by every devbench command that renders timestamps -- `devbench report`, `devbench hook-tail`, `devbench watch`, and any future command. When unset, each command defaults to the OS local timezone. Override per-invocation via the JUDGE_DISPLAY_TIMEZONE env var. Report-specific `report.display_timezone` / JUDGE_REPORT_TIMEZONE take precedence over this top-level setting for the report command only.

gh_api.description: GitHub API call timeout in seconds.

test.description: Test suite run timeout in seconds.

security_fetch.description: Security advisory fetch timeout in seconds.

llm.description: LLM API call timeout in seconds.

command.description: Shell command execution timeout in seconds.

executor.description: Executor agent overall timeout in seconds.

executor_max_turns.description: Maximum number of turns for the executor agent.

github_check.description: GitHub check status polling timeout in seconds.

update_submodule.description: When true, update the parent repo's submodule reference after each PR merge. Set to true only when target repos are git submodules of a parent workspace repo.

single_branch.description: When set, all work units use this branch name instead of per-unit backlog/<id> branches. Enables accumulating multiple commits on one branch for a single PR.

defer_pr.description: When true, git-ops commits locally only (no push, no PR, no merge). Use git-ops-finalize to push and create the PR after all work units are complete. Only meaningful when single_branch is set.

max_blocks.description: Maximum consecutive stop-hook blocks before circuit breaker trips and allows stop. Default: 5.

window_seconds.description: Time window in seconds for counting stop-hook blocks. Counter resets after this period. Default: 180.

stale_task_minutes.description: Minutes before an in-progress task is considered stale. Hook warns instead of blindly blocking. Default: 120.

alert_summary.description: Maximum number of security alert summaries to include.

output_truncation.description: Character limit for command output truncation.

llm_evidence_truncation.description: Character limit for LLM evidence content truncation.

llm_file_context.description: Maximum number of files included in LLM context.

llm_file_preview_chars.description: Character limit for per-file LLM preview.

token_cost_per_million_input.description: Cost per million input tokens in USD. Default: 15.0 (Opus list price).

token_cost_per_million_output.description: Cost per million output tokens in USD. Default: 75.0 (Opus list price).

display_timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. 'America/Denver', 'Europe/London') for displaying timestamps in `devbench report`. Defaults to the host system's local timezone. Useful when running inside a devcontainer or VM whose system TZ differs from your actual location. Override via JUDGE_REPORT_TIMEZONE env var.

cache_read_multiplier.description: Cost multiplier for cache-read tokens, relative to base input rate. Defaults to 0.10 (Anthropic's published rate). Override only when running on a platform with different caching pricing (e.g. some Bedrock configurations).

cache_write_5min_multiplier.description: Cost multiplier for 5-minute prompt-cache write tokens, relative to base input rate. Defaults to 1.25 (Anthropic's published rate).

cache_write_1hr_multiplier.description: Cost multiplier for 1-hour prompt-cache write tokens, relative to base input rate. Defaults to 2.0 (Anthropic's published rate).

data_residency_multiplier.description: Cost multiplier when usage.inference_geo is set (US-only inference). Defaults to 1.10 (Anthropic's published rate). Counted in v1 but not yet applied per-call.

recent_pace_tasks.description: Number of most-recently-completed tasks averaged for the 'Recent pace' projection in `devbench report`. Defaults to 10. Lower for more responsiveness, higher for more stability. Override via JUDGE_REPORT_RECENT_PACE_TASKS env var.

token_cost_discount.description: Contract discount (correction factor) off list-price token cost, as a fraction in [0.0, 1.0]. final_cost = raw_list_cost * (1 - token_cost_discount). Default 0.0 (no discount, pay full list). Applies uniformly to every per-call cost and to every ETA projection; cache multipliers stay as pure ratios applied to the discounted base rate. Override via JUDGE_REPORT_TOKEN_COST_DISCOUNT env var. See docs/model-pricing.md.

manifest_amendment.description: Opt-in configuration for the Changes Manifest amendment workflow. When enabled, executors that discover a required production fix during TDD GREEN can request an amendment to the Changes Manifest; a dedicated judge reviews the request, and on approval the manifest is updated atomically with a Layer 3 deterministic post-check.

enabled.description: Whether the amendment workflow is active for this backlog. Default false (opt-in).

allowed_reasons.description: List of amendment reasons this backlog accepts. Amendment requests whose reason is not in this list are rejected by the Layer 1 pre-filter. Default: ['tdd_green_production_fix'].

max_requests_per_execution.description: Maximum amendments applied to one task during one executor run. Default 1. Prevents amendment loops.

task_factory.description: Opt-in configuration for the task-factory loop. When enabled, the orchestrator invokes blocker-resolver + task-factory after an amendment reject to generate new `proposed` work units for the out-of-scope production fixes the amender surfaced. Requires manifest_amendment.enabled: true.

enabled.description: Whether the task-factory loop runs after amendment rejects. Default false (opt-in). Requires manifest_amendment.enabled: true.

auto_accept_proposals.description: When true, devbench auto-promotes every task-factory-produced draft at sweep time instead of leaving it at status `proposed` for operator review. Default false. ADR-11.
